520fd27cbd371a4782b0963f2add73c2e09f2a79.sourceText:
| 实车上可能看到的现象 | 先看哪些参数或条件 | 怎样理解 |
|---|---|---|
| 上坡或下坡远处的地面消失 | `lowerBoundZ`、`upperBoundZ`、`disRatioZ` | 它们决定相对输入雷达位置，向上、向下能保留多大的高度范围；本节点的范围会随水平距离扩大 |
| 正常坡面、下坡被画成障碍 | `useSorting`、`quantileZ`，以及下游10 cm障碍门槛 | 每一小片区域先选地面高度，再计算点离这个高度有多远；本节点远场对高低两侧都取绝对值，正常坡的较低侧也可能过门槛 |
| 同一障碍或坡面在4 m附近表现突然变化 | `localTerrainMapRadius` 与两个节点的规则差异 | 近场与远场的地面格子、点密度、高度上限和负高度差处理不同；要检查交接处，不能只调一边 |
| 想排除顶棚、判断地面是否与车旁连得上 | `checkTerrainConn` 及其三个配套参数 | 当前 False，专门的连接检查和顶棚筛选没有执行；`ceilingFilteringThre=2.0` 此时不起作用 |
| 人或障碍离开后，旧点没有在0.2秒消失 | `decayTime` 与两项 `voxel…UpdateThre` | 旧点只在缓存块更新时检查年龄；0.2秒不是准时删除的倒计时 |
| 以为 `clearingDis=20.0` 会自动清掉20 m外的点 | 清图事件与 `clearingDis` | 它仅在外部触发时清除20 m**内**的自身缓存，平时不按这个半径清图 |
520fd27cbd371a4782b0963f2add73c2e09f2a79.translatedText:
| Phenomena possibly observed on the actual vehicle | Which parameters or conditions to check first | How to understand |
|---|---|---|
| The ground disappears at a distance on uphill or downhill slopes | `lowerBoundZ`、`upperBoundZ`、`disRatioZ` | They determine the relative input radar position and how much height range can be retained upward and downward; the range of this node expands with horizontal distance |
| A normal slope or downhill is drawn as an obstacle | `useSorting`、`quantileZ`and the downstream 10 cm obstacle threshold | For each small patch of area, the ground height is first selected, then how far the point is from this height is calculated; in the far field, this node takes absolute values on both the high and low sides, so the lower side of a normal slope may also exceed the threshold |
| The same obstacle or slope shows a sudden change near 4 m | `localTerrainMapRadius` and the rule difference between the two nodes | The ground grid, point density, height upper limit, and negative height difference handling differ between near and far fields; the transition must be checked, and adjusting only one side is not enough |
| Want to exclude the ceiling and determine whether the ground is connected to the side of the vehicle | `checkTerrainConn` and its three supporting parameters | Currently False, so the dedicated connection check and ceiling filtering are not executed;`ceilingFilteringThre=2.0` does not take effect at this time |
| After a person or obstacle leaves, old points do not disappear within 0\.2 seconds | `decayTime` and two items `voxel…UpdateThre` | Old points are checked for age only when the cache block is updated; 0\.2 seconds is not a countdown for deletion on time |
| Think that `clearingDis=20.0` will automatically clear points beyond 20 m | Clear map event and `clearingDis` | It clears 20 m only when externally triggered**inside**of its own cache; normally it does not clear the map according to this radius |

5215bfc60dcaafe7cd30999abce3fd4c7d256c4f.sourceText:
*  静态成员变量
   *  所有对象共享同一份数据
   *  在编译阶段分配内存
   *  类内声明，类外初始化
*  静态成员函数
   *  所有对象共享同一个函数
   *  静态成员函数只能访问静态成员变量
5215bfc60dcaafe7cd30999abce3fd4c7d256c4f.translatedText:
*  Static member variables
   *  All objects share the same data
   *  Memory is allocated during the compilation phase
   *  Declared within the class, initialized outside the class
*  Static member functions
   *  All objects share the same function
   *  Static member functions can only access static member variables
